instruction:
Fix `packages/excalidraw/actions/actionPages.ts` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. yarn test:typecheck: packages/excalidraw/actions/actionPages.ts(62,13): error TS2304: Cannot find name 't'.
At runtime this throws `ReferenceError: t is not defined` at actionPages.ts:62:13 (perform of actionCreatePage, called from PageTabs.tsx:229 onClick), so creating a page does nothing. Import `t` the way other actions do (`import { t } from "../i18n";`, keeping eslint import order). These packages/excalidraw/tests/pages.test.tsx cases fail as a result:
pages > a whole-scene load through updateScene keeps every pageId :: AssertionError: expected [ 'id20' ] to deeply equal [ 'id21' ]
pages > create page switches to an empty page :: AssertionError: expected 1 to be 2 // Object.is equality
pages > deleting the active page activates a neighbour and undo restores it :: AssertionError: expected 1 to be 3 // Object.is equality
pages > image export contains only the active page :: AssertionError: expected 2 to be 1 // Object.is equality
pages > new elements land on the active page :: AssertionError: expected +0 to be 1 // Object.is equality
pages > only the active page is rendered and selectable :: AssertionError: expected +0 to be 1 // Object.is equality
pages > reorder from the tab bar persists :: AssertionError: expected 1 to be 3 // Object.is equality
pages > search switches to the page of a result :: AssertionError: expected 'default' not to be 'default' // Object.is equality
pages > undo stays on its page :: AssertionError: expected 1 to be +0 // Object.is equality
pages > updateScene adding an element puts it on the active page :: AssertionError: expected undefined to be 'default' // Object.is equality
pages > viewport is restored per page :: AssertionError: expected 'default' not to be 'default' // Object.is equality
